服务商文档里的 OpenAI 兼容地址，通常以 /v1 结尾: The OpenAI-compatible address from the provider's documentation, usually ending in /v1
模型名以服务商页面为准，可以改成你想用的: The provider's page is the authority for model names; change it to the one you want
这个密钥来自环境变量 STUDYHUB_API_KEY，不能在这里清除；要换掉它: This key comes from the environment variable STUDYHUB_API_KEY and cannot be cleared here; to replace it, change the system's environment variable.
ZCode 版不能在应用内升级。按下面 4 步换成新版本，学习库、模型和设置都会: The ZCode edition cannot upgrade itself. Follow these 4 steps to switch to the new version; your library, model and settings stay:
解压到一个固定的文件夹（不要放进 Program Files）；可以覆盖旧版所在: Extract it to a folder that stays put (not under Program Files); over the old version's folder is fine.
双击文件夹里的 install.bat，等它显示完成。: Double-click install.bat in that folder and wait until it says Done.
下载的 zip 先右键「属性」勾选「解除锁定」再解压，否则 Windows 可能: Before extracting, right-click the downloaded zip, open Properties and tick Unblock; otherwise Windows may stop install.bat.
选一个服务商（智谱、硅基流动、DeepSeek 都能国内直连），按卡片上的两步拿: Choose a provider (Zhipu, SiliconFlow and DeepSeek are reachable from mainland China) and get an API key with the two steps on its card
粘贴 API Key，点「保存并测试」: Paste the API key and select Save and test
打开智谱开放平台，用手机号注册并登录: Open the Zhipu open platform and sign up or sign in with a phone number
在「API Keys」页新建一个密钥并复制: On the API Keys page, create a key and copy it
在 DeepSeek 开放平台注册并登录: Sign up or sign in on the DeepSeek open platform
在「API keys」页创建一个密钥并复制: On the API keys page, create a key and copy it
有后台任务在进行（转换、转写、出题等）。它们属于开始它们的那个对话：关掉那个对话: Background tasks are running (conversion, transcription, question generation…). They belong to the chat that started them: closing that chat or quitting ZCode ends them; finished parts are kept, and you can select Continue later.
出题、讲解和批改时，所选资料会发送到这个接口；密钥只保存在这台电脑的 Study: When making questions, explaining or grading, the selected material is sent to this endpoint; the key is kept only in StudyHub's configuration file on this computer. Background tasks belong to the chat that started them; closing that chat or quitting ZCode ends them, and finished parts are kept.
完全退出 ZCode 后重新打开；退出会结束所有对话里正在运行的后台任务，已完成: Quit ZCode completely and open it again; quitting ends the background tasks running in every chat, and finished parts are kept.
换成另一个服务商的地址时，已保存的 Key 会被清除，要重新粘贴。: Changing to another provider's address clears the saved key; paste it again.
接口换到了另一个服务商，原来的 Key 已清除；请粘贴新服务商的 Key。: The address now belongs to another provider, so the previous key was cleared; paste the new provider's key.
